title: Session Credential Falsification through Prediction
sub: CAPEC-59 · likelihood: high
body: This attack targets predictable session ID in order to gain privileges. The attacker can predict the session ID used during a transaction to perform spoofing and session hijacking.

title: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Information Disclosure Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2023-26083 · exploited in the wild, listed 2023-04-07
body: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows a non-privileged user to make valid GPU processing operations that expose sensitive kernel metadata. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: ownCloud Improper Authentication Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2023-49105 · exploited in the wild, listed 2026-08-27
body: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured. What to do: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. title: Input Capture
sub: T1056 · collection, credential access
body: Adversaries may use methods of capturing user input to obtain credentials or collect information. During normal system usage, users often provide credentials to various different locations, such as login pages/portals or system dialog boxes. Input capture mechanisms may be transparent to the user (e.g. Credential API Hooking) or rely on deceiving the user into providing input into what they believe to be a genuine service (e.g. Web Portal Capture).

title: Apple iOS Type Confusion Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2022-42856 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-12-14
body: Apple iOS contains a type confusion vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content leading to code execution. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: D-Link DSL-2760U Gateway Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2013-5223 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-03-25
body: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the D-Link DSL-2760U gateway, allowing remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script or HTML. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: DEPRECATED: XSS through Log Files
sub: CAPEC-106
body: This attack pattern has been deprecated as it referes to an existing chain relationship between "CAPEC-93 : Log Injection-Tampering-Forging" and "CAPEC-63 : Cross-Site Scripting". Please refer to these CAPECs going forward.

title: Draytek VigorConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2021-20124 · exploited in the wild, listed 2024-09-03
body: Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the file download functionality of the WebServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges. What to do: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

title: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows Uncontrolled Search Path Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2020-3153 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-10-24 · used by ransomware
body: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows allows for incorrect handling of directory paths. An attacker with valid credentials on Windows would be able to copy malicious files to arbitrary locations with system level privileges. This could include DLL pre-loading, DLL hijacking, and other related attacks. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Laravel Ignition File Upload Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2021-3129 · exploited in the wild, listed 2023-09-18 · used by ransomware
body: Laravel Ignition contains a file upload vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute malicious code due to insecure usage of file_get_contents() and file_put_contents(). What to do: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

title: Fortra Cobalt Strike Teamserver Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2022-39197 · exploited in the wild, listed 2023-03-30
body: Fortra Cobalt Strike contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Teamserver that would allow an attacker to set a malformed username in the Beacon configuration, allowing them to execute code remotely. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Unspecified Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2018-19320 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-10-24 · used by ransomware
body: The GDrv low-level driver in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II exposes ring0 memcpy-like functionality that could allow a local attacker to take complete control of the affected system. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Code Inclusion
sub: CAPEC-175 · likelihood: medium
body: An adversary exploits a weakness on the target to force arbitrary code to be retrieved locally or from a remote location and executed. This differs from code injection in that code injection involves the direct inclusion of code while code inclusion involves the addition or replacement of a reference to a code file, which is subsequently loaded by the target and used as part of the code of some application.

title: F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2020-5902 · exploited in the wild, listed 2021-11-03 · used by ransomware
body: F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI) contains a remote code execution vulnerability in undisclosed pages. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Security Control Bypass Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2025-40536 · exploited in the wild, listed 2026-02-12
body: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a security control bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain access to certain restricted functionality. What to do: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

title: Hardware Additions
sub: T1200 · initial access
body: Adversaries may physically introduce computer accessories, networking hardware, or other computing devices into a system or network that can be used as a vector to gain access. Rather than just connecting and distributing payloads via removable storage (i.e. Replication Through Removable Media), more robust hardware additions can be used to introduce new functionalities and/or features into a system that can then be abused. While public references of usage by threat actors are scarce, many red teams/penetration testers leverage hardware additions for initial access. Commercial and open source products can be leveraged with capabilities such as passive network tapping, network traffic…

title: Influence Perception of Liking
sub: CAPEC-423 · likelihood: medium
body: The adversary influences the target's actions by building a relationship where the target has a liking to the adversary. People are more likely to be influenced by people of whom they are fond, so the adversary attempts to ingratiate themself with the target via actions, appearance, or a combination thereof.

title: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2026-102490 · exploited in the wild, listed 2026-10-02
body: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489. What to do: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

title: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls OS Command Injection Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2022-30525 · exploited in the wild, listed 2022-05-16
body: A command injection vulnerability in the CGI program of some Zyxel firewall versions could allow an attacker to modify specific files and then execute some OS commands on a vulnerable device. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2026-81578 · exploited in the wild, listed 2026-08-31
body: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078. What to do: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. title: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2024-9380 · exploited in the wild, listed 2024-10-09
body: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS. What to do: As Ivanti CSA 4.6.x has reached End-of-Life status, users are urged to remove CSA 4.6.x from service or upgrade to the 5.0.x line, or later, of supported solution.

title: Apache Log4j2 Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2021-45046 · exploited in the wild, listed 2023-05-01 · used by ransomware
body: Apache Log4j2 contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability due to the incomplete fix of CVE-2021-44228, where the Thread Context Lookup Pattern is vulnerable to remote code execution in certain non-default configurations. What to do: Apply updates per vendor instructions.

title: Exploiting Incorrect Chaining or Granularity of Hardware Debug Components
sub: CAPEC-702 · likelihood: low
body: An adversary exploits incorrect chaining or granularity of hardware debug components in order to gain unauthorized access to debug functionality on a chip. This happens when authorization is not checked on a per function basis and is assumed for a chain or group of debug functionality.

title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
sub: CVE-2026-20182 · exploited in the wild, listed 2026-05-14
body: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller & Manager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system. What to do: Please adhere to CISA’s guidelines to assess exposure and mitigate risks associated with Cisco SD-WAN devices as outlined in CISA’s Emergency Directive 26-03 (URL listed below in Notes) and CISA’s Hunt & Hardening Guidance for Cisco SD-WAN Devices (URL listed below in Notes). Adhere to the applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are not available.

title: Disable Security Software
sub: CAPEC-578 · likelihood: medium
body: An adversary exploits a weakness in access control to disable security tools so that detection does not occur. This can take the form of killing processes, deleting registry keys so that tools do not start at run time, deleting log files, or other methods.
